pages.text: Right-click a pipe with a dye. Pipes of $(thing)two different colours never connect$(); undyed pipes connect to every colour. Using the pipe's own colour again washes it off.

Craft eight blank facades, then combine a blank facade with any full block to get a facade of that block. Right-click a pipe with it to hide the pipe; it keeps working.$(br2)A data pack can forbid blocks with the $(thing)flowline:no_facade$() block tag.
